hero.title: A regenerative farm in tune with nature
hero.subtitle: Pastured chicken, eggs, geese, rabbits, and vegetables straight from the farmer

about.title: Get to know our farm
about.description: We are a small regenerative farm in Křepice near Hustopeče. We focus on animal welfare and gentle treatment of the soil we farm on.

chickens.title: pasture-raised chickens
chickens.body: Until 8 weeks of age they live on pasture inside a fenced enclosure with a movable shelter we shift regularly. They have constant access to fresh grass and insects. The result is meat with a full, natural flavour incomparable with intensively farmed birds.

rabbits.title: our rabbits
rabbits.body: We raise them on pasture in mobile enclosures we move twice a day. This keeps the animals healthy and clean while enriching the soil with the nutrients it needs for natural meadow regeneration.

hens.title: our hens
hens.body: We keep them in the orchard from spring through autumn while the grass is growing. Fresh grass, foraging for beetles, sunshine, and clean air guarantee great-tasting eggs and a contented life for our hens.

geese.title: pastured geese
geese.body: Our geese have access to a spacious meadow with quality pasture from spring through autumn, supporting natural growth and development. The meat has outstanding taste and quality. Most of our geese are sold around St. Martin's Day.

vegetables.title: chemical-free vegetables
vegetables.body: We grow our vegetables without chemical herbicides or pesticides. We use only natural fertiliser made from our own animals' compost.

microgreens.title: microgreens
microgreens.body: Young shoots of pea, radish, and sunflower. Packed with vitamins and the intense flavour of mature plants. Great in salads, on bread, or as a plate garnish.

cookies.intro: This site, kurnik-sopa.cz, operated by [Name/Company, Address, Reg. No.] (the "Operator" or "we"), uses cookies. This policy explains what cookies are, which categories we use, and how you can manage or disable them.
cookies.section1Body: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser (on your computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit it. They allow the site to remember information about your visit (such as your language, cart contents, or login state) so your next visit can be smoother.
cookies.section2Title: 2. What categories of cookies do we use?
cookies.section2Intro: On kurnik-sopa.cz we use cookies grouped by their purpose and lifetime.
cookies.section2DurationSession: Session cookies: Deleted from your device automatically when you close the browser.
cookies.section2DurationPersistent: Persistent cookies: Remain on your device for a longer period (depending on the cookie's settings or your browser) until you delete them.
cookies.section2NecessaryDesc: Essential for the site to function (cart, login, security). Without them the shop would not work.
cookies.section2AnalyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors use the site (e.g. which pages are most visited). Data is anonymized.
cookies.section2MarketingDesc: Used to track users across sites and to show relevant advertising (e.g. on social networks or search engines).
cookies.section3Intro: Our site may integrate third-party tools that also store cookies (third-party cookies):
cookies.section3Tool1: Google Analytics: For traffic and behavior analysis (analytics cookies).
cookies.section3Tool2: Google Ads / Sklik: For ad campaign measurement and ad targeting (marketing cookies).
cookies.section3Tool3: Facebook Pixel: For conversion tracking and ad personalization on Facebook (marketing cookies).
cookies.section3ToolMore: [Add others you use, or remove this line.]
cookies.section4Title: 4. How can you change your cookie settings?
cookies.section4ASubtitle: A) Via the cookie banner on our site
cookies.section4ABody: On your first visit the cookie banner appears. There you can choose which categories of cookies (analytics, marketing) you allow. You can change or withdraw this consent at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.
cookies.section4BBody: Most browsers accept cookies automatically but let you disable, limit, or delete them in their settings. See the documentation for Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari (Mac/iOS), or Microsoft Edge.
cookies.section4Warning: Note: If you disable cookies entirely in your browser, parts of this site (especially cart and login) may not function correctly.
cookies.section5Body: Storing cookies may involve processing of personal data (e.g. IP address). For more on your rights and how we handle personal data, see our Privacy Policy.
